[.verse-line]
[.i261]##{nbsp}##My Love and I for Kisses play’d,
[.i261]##{nbsp}##She would keep stakes, I was content,
[.i259]##{nbsp}##But when I won she would be paid;
[.i245]##{nbsp}##This made me ask her what she meant:
[.i144]##{nbsp}##Quoth she, since you are in this wrangling vein,
[.i142]##{nbsp}##Here take your Kisses, give me mine again.
